scope.sourceReview: All scene dispatch branches and stages were inspected; runtime regression cases focus on concrete mismatches and asynchronous gates. This is not a claim that all 1000 games were manually played.

findings.before: 盖板未打开时提示点小喇叭，实际句子卡不存在
findings.resolution: 先明确擦/点盖板，打开8块后再听/看句子
findings.evidence: reveal instructions expose a cover before any sentence speaker

findings.before: 父层捕获使普通按钮单击无法揭盖，双引擎均实测失败
findings.resolution: pointerDown按真实落点揭盖，拖动同源；键盘onClick保留；8块门槛不变
findings.evidence: reveal instructions expose a cover before any sentence speaker

findings.before: 点句子卡即heard，取消或尚未播完仍可选词
findings.resolution: 仅Promise true解锁，取消可重试，播放中禁选；静音先看句子
findings.evidence: generic sentence choices unlock only after successful playback

findings.before: 点听一听立即能作答，未等实际完整声音
findings.resolution: 真实完成解锁本轮；取消不计；静音看本轮铃铛/鼓提示
findings.evidence: hearing waits for completion and does not accept canceled narration

findings.before: 认字点播放即允许推进
findings.resolution: 真实播放完成才heard；明确忙态；静音阅读入口
findings.evidence: recognition listens to completion before enabling progression

findings.resolution: 两个示范分别完成后记录，取消不计；家长确认保持手动
findings.evidence: follow-reading marks only fully played word and sentence demonstrations

findings.before: 改为异步后旧单字/阶段/声音上下文可能被迟到完成污染
findings.resolution: 请求token+当前word/stage/sound上下文；卸载/推进/切静音使旧结果失效
findings.evidence: old playback cannot update a newly active lesson or a muted state

findings.before: 关闭总声音仍写先听并缺明确替代入口
findings.resolution: 静音看句子、看提示、阅读或家长确认；不伪造持久化听音字段
findings.evidence: muted recognition and follow-reading remain operable without fake heard flags

findings.before: 问小兔子在说哪个字，但没有小兔
findings.resolution: 直接问词语里有哪个字；静音指向先前词语
findings.evidence: muted recognition and follow-reading remain operable without fake heard flags

findings.before: 真实拉开窗帘却说窗打开了
findings.resolution: 窗帘拉开了，阳光照进来。
findings.evidence: window completion describes opening curtains, not opening the window

findings.before: 已显示两块瓜，提示和反馈仍说打开/切成两半
findings.resolution: 明确分开两块西瓜，保留滑块与按钮
findings.evidence: watermelon instructions match the two visible pieces and separation

findings.resolution: 把种子种进松软的泥土；按实际种/浇操作

findings.evidence: worm and soil instructions name the actual targets and planting action

findings.before: 正在听诗主按钮点击会暂停，文字未说明
findings.resolution: 忙主按钮只表示状态并禁用；独立暂停仍可操作
findings.evidence: poem busy button is a status, with a separate functional pause action

findings.before: 图例真实播完原文行但未记录已听，导致提示与进度不一致
findings.resolution: 匹配原文时统一readLine；完成true才记录该行

findings.before: 持久化activityDone为true，重开两个确认仍未完成/第二个禁用
findings.resolution: 本地activity从既有完成字段恢复为2，不改持久化schema
findings.evidence: muted poem progresses by reading and restores completed practice indicators

findings.before: 点击已分享发现后播邀请再向动物分享

limitations: These controlled narration tests establish UI gating semantics, not real file completion, timbre or physical iPad behavior.
The origin fixture does not execute the deployed App JS; independent asset byte checks bind the served JS/CSS to local production build but do not replace parent App integration tests.
Static scene review and focused browser regressions have different coverage; no claim that every word, audio phrase or all page states were interactively tested here.
Ordinary optional replay buttons are not mandatory listening gates; global sound suppression is owned by App.
